description: This file contains shell functions related to managing system events (sysevent) in a network device environment. It includes functions to facilitate remote sysevent communication via IPv6, and to register/unregister sysevent handlers for services and events.

methods.name: sysevent_np
methods.description: Facilitates remote sysevent to NP's linked local IPv6 address. It retrieves the IP address from sysevent and executes the sysevent command with proper escaping.

methods.name: sysevent_ap
methods.description: Facilitates remote sysevent to AP's linked local IPv6 address. Similar to sysevent_np but for AP, it retrieves and sends the IP address via sysevent.

methods.name: register_sysevent_handler
methods.description: Registers a sysevent handler for a service and event, and records the async ID for later unregistration. It accepts service name, event name, handler, and optional flag.

methods.name: unregister_sysevent_handler
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered sysevent handler using the stored async ID, for given service and event.
